refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: The ne_session_abort function aborts a request in progress for the given session. The request will fail with the error code NE_ABORTED at the next point at which the abort is detected, and the connection will be closed.

ne_session_abort is async-signal safe, and may be called from a signal handler delivered in the thread which is using the session. The function itself performs no I/O and allocates no memory; it merely records the abort for the request layer to act upon.

refsect1.title: Notes
refsect1.para: A request which is blocked waiting to read from the connection is interrupted within approximately one second; for an SSL connection, this excludes a read which is blocked inside the TLS library waiting for the remainder of a partially received record, and the TLS handshake. A request which is blocked writing to the connection is not interrupted; the abort takes effect once that write completes. If the write fails first, the request fails with the error code for that failure (for example NE_TIMEOUT) and the abort remains pending.

The abort is consumed by the first request operation which detects it. If no request is in progress when ne_session_abort is called, the next request using the session will fail with NE_ABORTED; a subsequent request will then proceed as normal.

refsect1.title: Return value
refsect1.para: The ne_session_abort function returns no value.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: ne_session_abort is available in &neon; 0.38.0 and later.
